narrative.overview: A clear, patient product that helps without taking over. Speaking and understanding remain one-step tasks, and privacy limits are visible in the interface.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue signals action or selection, never decoration.

rules.name: The Read-It-Once Rule
rules.body: Punjabi results are large enough to understand without zooming.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from tonal layering rather than decorative shadows.

dos: Use system typography and familiar Android interactions.
donts: Do not use emojis or decorative controls.
Do not use Accessibility screen reading or overlays.
Do not show clipboard or network tools in secure fields.
